title: Ethel Waters in 'Callico'; a record played
summary: He praises Ethel Waters, recalls Bix taking him to see her sing 'I'm Coming Virginia', and plays the record.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Yes I have several of her records here. I have her records collector's items.

She sang in a show called 'Callico' and Bix Beiderbecke took me to see that show with her. And you could hear it, Ethel Waters. And she sang a number called 'I'm Coming Virginia'. And was it something.
Do you have that on record?
Do you have it with you?
Yes. Do you want to hear it?
tape speed changes from 1 7/8 to 7 1/2 ips
Jimmy I would just have to say that that's another high. (LAUGHTER). And moving on up higher as they say. Oh, I'm sorry, go ahead.
I was going to say that Ethel Waters is a classic person and a musician. And anything she's done has been to me just beautiful.
I listen to her records when I have time over and over again and there's a clarity too to her, to her voice.
She's basically a fine person and it comes out in her acting in her singing and her personality. All the way around, she's just a gorgeous woman.
